summary: First end-to-end pass for Golden Nuggets Admin CMS. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases pass (auth, sermons CRUD/publish/bulk/feature, meetings CRUD/publish, categories CRUD with 409 on duplicate slug and assign, media upload/list/usage/serve/delete via Emergent Object Storage, dashboard stats, settings GET/PATCH, import preview+publish). Frontend: login->dashboard redirect, all sidebar links navigate correctly, sermon create->edit redirect, meeting create, category create + duplicate-slug blocked, import center preview+publish, media upload appears in list, settings tab navigation and Save persist correctly.

minor.issue: branham.org returns 404 for the reference URL https://branham.org/en/messagesaudio/GoingBeyondTheCamp from this environment (Microsoft-IIS/legacy.branham.org backend). The FastAPI scraper itself is correct — verified with https://example.com/ returning 200 and populating title. Main agent may need to adjust the sample URL or scraper URL slug format.

When httpx raises_for_status (e.g. Wikipedia 403 or branham 404), the endpoint returns 502 with the underlying error string. This is by design; consider returning 422/400 for client-error upstream responses so the UI shows a cleaner message than 'Failed to fetch page: 404 Not Found'.

issues: Zero-value counts (total_sermons, total_meetings, featured, recently_added) render as '—' instead of '0'. Numeric intent is unclear until data exists. Not blocking.

action_items: Consider updating the sample Branham.org URL in docs / import center placeholder to a working slug (e.g. verify current branham.org URL structure — legacy Microsoft-IIS host is returning 404 for /en/messagesaudio/*).
Optional: map upstream 4xx from httpx to HTTP 400 (bad URL) instead of 502 (bad gateway) in /api/import/preview.
Optional: render 0 instead of '—' on dashboard stat cards when the count is genuinely zero.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py sets cookies with secure=False. Since the app is served over HTTPS in preview/production, cookies should be secure=True to prevent MITM cookie exfiltration. Sensitive httpOnly refresh tokens are currently transmittable over any protocol.

auth.py brute-force lockout keys on 'ip:email'. If two clients from different IPs guess against same account, they don't share a counter — acceptable for now but note per-email counter is not enforced.

storage_service.py uses synchronous 'requests' inside async FastAPI endpoints (media upload/download). This blocks the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or offloading to run_in_executor for high concurrency.

server.py CORS 'allow_origins' defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore this combo. Currently harmless because cookies flow same-origin via ingress, but explicit origin list is safer.

import_center.py year computation `str(1900 + year_prefix)` produces 1900+YY (e.g. 65 -> 1965), but the branch `if year_prefix < 70 else str(1900 + year_prefix)` is identical in both arms — likely intended `2000 + year_prefix` for years < 70. Cosmetic bug in derived year value.
Frontend AuthContext relies on /auth/me; ensure a 401 there transitions to /login (verified working via ProtectedRoute).
seed_data_creation: Tests self-clean: TEST_ prefixed sermons/meetings/categories/media all deleted at end of respective test cases. One UI-created 'Test Sermon' (draft) and 'Test Meeting' (upcoming) plus 'UITest Cat' category remain in DB from playwright run — main agent may wipe if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 36 tests, ~24s). Import preview test uses example.com fallback when Branham.org is unreachable. Frontend selectors used: login-form, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, dashboard-page, sermons-page, create-sermon-btn (present on empty state? use direct nav /sermons/new instead), sermon-form-page, sermon-title-input, sermon-speaker-input, save-draft-btn, meetings-page, add-meeting-btn, meeting-title-input, publish-meeting-btn, categories-page, add-category-btn, cat-name-input, cat-save-btn, import-center-page, import-url-input, import-run-btn, import-preview, import-publish-btn, media-page, media-upload-input (hidden input — use set_input_files), settings-page, settings-tab-<key>, setting-<key>, save-settings-btn.
